annotations.title: Attach a channel identity to a lead

description:
Attach a verified or claimed identity to a lead.

Luca operation: POST /api/leads/{id}/identities
Required scopes: leads:write
Required OAuth scope: luca:draft; data sensitivity: full_content
Requires Idempotency-Key. Provide idempotencyKey for safe retries, or the server will generate one.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for safe retries. If omitted, the MCP server generates a unique key for this call.

name: luca_leads_identities_attach
title: Attach a channel identity to a lead
